purpose: Freeze per-suite dimensions, objective direction, fixed bounds, scorer scope and metric convention for independent receipt scoring.

test_only_hv_2d.note: Test-only known-answer fixture contract; must never be used for empirical result claims.

auc_convention.curve: stepwise hypervolume after each objective-oracle call
auc_convention.integration: sum observed step values; if a successful run reaches a predeclared target before planned budget, carry final observed HV to remaining budget steps
auc_convention.denominator: planned objective-evaluation budget multiplied by fixed normalization_area

evidence_rules: The scorer verifies receipt protocol_sha256 and analysis_lock_sha256 against the exact checked-out file bytes.
The scorer verifies receipt trace_schema_sha256 and scorer_sha256 against the exact checked-out file bytes.
Run-specific bounds must exactly match the immutable suite contract; per-algorithm or per-run reference changes are prohibited.
Test-only suite contracts require synthetic_fixture_only=true and are never publishable empirical evidence.
COCO runs use native target-reaching/runtime and ECDF outputs; this custom AUC is not a replacement for official COCO analysis.
